tier1_metros.name: Los Angeles
tier1_metros.meet_in_person: Our office is in LA. Meet Trevor in person at 7951 Blackburn Ave, or we can come to your property or office anywhere in the LA metro.
tier1_metros.market_notes: LA is the backyard for Commercial Lending Solutions. We close deals across LA County every month: Westside (Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Culver City), DTLA and Arts District, Hollywood and Mid-Wilshire, the Valley (Burbank, Glendale, Sherman Oaks, Van Nuys), Long Beach, and the port-adjacent industrial corridor (Vernon, Commerce, Carson).
tier1_metros.typical_submarkets: Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Culver City, Downtown LA, Arts District, Koreatown, Hollywood, Mid-Wilshire, West LA, Sherman Oaks, Burbank, Pasadena, Long Beach, Vernon, Commerce

tier1_metros.name: San Francisco
tier1_metros.meet_in_person: We travel to the Bay Area regularly to meet with sponsors, lenders, and developers in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, and the Peninsula.
tier1_metros.market_notes: San Francisco CRE is dominated by tech-office bifurcation (Class A credit-tenant still funds, Class B CBD struggles), ground-up multifamily with local affordability overlays, mission-district and SOMA mixed-income LIHTC deals, and Peninsula biotech / life sciences.
tier1_metros.typical_submarkets: Mission, SOMA, Downtown / Financial District, Nob Hill, Marina, Bayview / Hunters Point, Tenderloin, Outer Mission, Visitacion Valley

tier1_metros.name: San Diego
tier1_metros.meet_in_person: Our LA office is 2 hours from San Diego and we meet with SD sponsors regularly, either on-site or at Trevor's LA office.
tier1_metros.market_notes: San Diego CRE features strong multifamily fundamentals (military and biotech demand), active industrial along the I-15 and Otay Mesa corridors, biotech life sciences in Torrey Pines and Sorrento Valley, and hospitality in downtown, La Jolla, and coastal markets.
tier1_metros.typical_submarkets: Downtown San Diego, La Jolla, Torrey Pines, Sorrento Valley, Carlsbad, Escondido, Chula Vista, National City, Barrio Logan, Mid-City

tier1_metros.name: San Jose
tier1_metros.meet_in_person: We meet with San Jose and greater Silicon Valley sponsors in person for deals meaningful enough to justify the trip from LA.
tier1_metros.market_notes: San Jose CRE is driven by Silicon Valley tech demand, aggressive multifamily ground-up under Measure E, SB 35 ministerial approval utilization, and strong deal flow in Sunnyvale / Santa Clara / Mountain View industrial-flex.
tier1_metros.typical_submarkets: Downtown San Jose, Alum Rock, East San Jose, Berryessa, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Mountain View, Campbell, Willow Glen

tier1_metros.name: Sacramento
tier1_metros.meet_in_person: We travel to Sacramento for significant deals and coordinate with SHRA, HCD, and state programs on-site when needed.
tier1_metros.market_notes: Sacramento is a strategic market as California's capital and a priority metro for state HCD funding programs (HHAP, NPLH, AHSC, MHP). Strong affordable housing pipeline, active mixed-use development along the Blue Line, and ground-up market-rate in Midtown and Oak Park.
tier1_metros.typical_submarkets: Downtown Sacramento, Midtown, Oak Park, Del Paso Heights, Meadowview, North Sacramento, Arden-Arcade, Florin, South Sacramento

tier1_loan_types.name: Commercial Real Estate Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: broadest search. Sponsor looking for a broker to source commercial real estate financing across any asset class and loan type.
tier1_loan_types.typical_deal_range: $5M to $200M+ across all CRE asset classes
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Permanent (life company, CMBS, agency multifamily), bridge and transitional debt, construction and ground-up, SBA 504 / 7(a) owner-user, mezzanine and preferred equity, specialty (data center, cold storage, self-storage, hospitality)

tier1_loan_types.name: Multifamily Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: multifamily-specific search. Apartment sponsor, syndicator, or developer.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Fannie Mae DUS (Small Balance, Target, Green Advantage), Freddie Mac Optigo (Target, SBL, Optigo Green), CMBS conduit, life insurance company permanent, value-add bridge (debt funds and mortgage REITs), ground-up construction, HUD 221(d)(4) and 223(f), workforce multifamily, affordable / LIHTC

tier1_loan_types.name: Bridge Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: bridge-specific search. Transitional, value-add, acquisition, or repositioning.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Debt fund senior bridge, mortgage REIT bridge, construction bridge, acquisition bridge, value-add renovation bridge, predevelopment bridge, note purchase bridge, DIP financing

tier1_loan_types.name: Construction Loans
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Bank construction (regional + national), debt fund non-bank construction, life company construction-to-permanent, HUD 221(d)(4), build-to-suit with credit tenant forward commitment, SBA 504 owner-user construction

tier1_loan_types.name: SBA Commercial Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: SBA-specific search. Owner-user buying or building their own commercial property.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: SBA 504 first mortgage + CDC debenture (up to 90% LTC), SBA 7(a) working capital + real estate, SBA express, owner-user manufacturing, owner-user medical / dental, owner-user restaurant and retail, owner-user warehouse
